articles.title: Strong Opinions, Loosely Held
articles.summary: AI makes building cheaper, not product judgment easier. Strategy, customer understanding, and independent thinking matter more than ever.

articles.title: Cracks in the AI Thesis Part 2
articles.summary: Anthropic extended its lead in business AI adoption, though overall growth slowed and spending by top users dropped nearly 10% in August. Falling token prices and a shift to cheaper models are cutting costs, while open-source and Chinese models account for little corporate usage.

articles.title: Don't let AI automate the mess out of product development
articles.summary: Don't automate away productive friction. Use AI for routine work, but keep humans in the conversations where judgment and alignment happen.

articles.title: Product Management is Still All About Telling Stories
articles.summary: AI makes building cheap, but judgment still defines great products. The PM's job is to choose what matters and tell a story users understand.

articles.title: The product process that saved us weeks of wasted development
articles.summary: Catch bad product architecture before you build it. Validate early, and let the structure of the problem shape the solution.

articles.title: Congrats, your sales problems in PLG are completely unoriginal
articles.summary: Don't kill PLG to grow enterprise. Let product adoption create enterprise demand, then use sales when customers actually need it.

articles.title: How To Find Meaning In Life
articles.summary: Meaning comes from commitment, not endless options. Invest deeply in people, purpose, and work that matters beyond yourself.

articles.title: Catching the (Venture) Bus
articles.summary: Tech's biggest winners are increasingly built in private markets. Traditional venture allocations may be too small, but access to the best funds matters more than broad exposure.

articles.title: Why Spotify Still Uses Frequentist A/B Testing
articles.summary: Bayesian A/B testing is only as useful as its priors.

articles.title: Distinguishing decisions from assumptions
articles.summary: AI can make assumptions look like decisions.
